major_caveats: EVENT_GROUND_TRUTH: No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.
MISSING_MONTH_KILN_I_SEPTEMBER: Kiln-I September 2025 workbook is truncated and unreadable, so the score ends 2025-08-23 and September is not scored. Nothing is imputed.
KILN_IIIA_APRIL_DUPLICATION: The Kiln-IIIA April file repeats May data; April is absent for that dataset.
UNIT_REVIEW_HOLDS: 13 columns are held pending plant unit confirmation and are excluded from the score.

O2_ANALYSER_KILN_I_X: Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.
LOAD_DEPENDENCE: The score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
OPERATING_STATE_PROXY: RUNNING / STOPPED is a POC proxy from Kiln MD and feed; the meaning of Kiln MD and the equipment identity are unconfirmed.
REFERENCE_DEPENDENCE: Band levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.
CENSORED_ONSETS: 6 of the 12 abnormal-period onsets are censored by the look-back cap; the small positive pre-onset estimate comes from them.
TIMEZONE: The historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.

periods.timestamp_semantics: timezone-naive historian export (no timezone supplied; plant question open). Scores are 10-min buckets labelled by bucket end: a row at T covers (T - 10 min, T]. Timestamps are served exactly as stored, never converted, resampled or filled.
